# Arkynos

> Arkynos is a free university study-resource library where students share and find past questions, lecture notes, textbooks, lab manuals and solution manuals organized by department, programme, year, semester and course.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Browse recent resources, search by course code, and join the community.
- [Search](/search): Search courses by code, name or department with fuzzy matching.
- [Recent Resources](/recent): The latest resources uploaded by the community.
- [Department of Mechanical Engineering](/department/Mechanical%20Engineering): Browse Mechanical, Automobile and Marine Engineering programmes.
- [Class Collections](/classes): Browse class-tagged resource bundles for specific cohorts.
- [Upload](/upload): Contribute a resource to the library.
- [Upgrade](/upgrade): Get unlimited downloads with a per-semester premium pass.
- [Mad As Math](/mad-as-math): Curated mathematics resources.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the Arkynos admins.

## Optional
